title: Literal index bound
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula over variables indexed by the natural numbers, let $C$ be one of its clauses, and let $\ell=(v,b)$ be a literal in $C$. Then $v<N(\varphi)$, where $N(\varphi)$ is the variable count of $\varphi$.
replaced:
Let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula, $C$ a clause of $\varphi$, and $\ell = (v, b)$ a literal
of $C$. Then $v$ is strictly less than the variable bound of $\varphi$, i.e.\ one more
than the largest variable index occurring in $\varphi$.
